The apply_template returned two possible precursors (two possible disconnections). The template appears to be a cyclization forming a cyclic ether? Actually the retro template is [C:1]/[CH]=[CH]/[C:4]>>[C:1]-[C@@H]1-O-[C@H]1-[C:4] which is a ring closure forming a tetrahydrofuran? The product is our target, which is a cyclic diol with side chain.

The precursors returned are:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/[C@@H]2O[C@H]2C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'

2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'

These are similar but differ in geometry of side chain.

We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves commercially available, total cost <= $9999.

We need to check if these precursors are commercially available. Use is_buyable.
